_README: AURA curated knowledge base — answered FREE on the FIRST ask (no LLM). RULES: only STABLE, TRUE, NON-VOLATILE facts (never prices/news/opinions/dates-that-change). Each entry: q = array of phrasings (all normalized + matched exactly, plus fuzzy), a = the answer. Edit/extend freely; it's version-controlled. Volatile prompts are ignored even if seeded.

q: what is the aura token saver
entries.a: AURA is SHADDAI's token-saver. It answers prompts WITHOUT calling an AI whenever possible — exact-match cache, this curated knowledge base, ~34 local compute solvers (math, units, dates, text), and deterministic recipes. Anything it can't answer truthfully it hands to the real AI. Live monitor: /aura.html.

AURA answers for free three ways: FETCH (exact-match cache), COMPUTE (real local math/units/dates — no AI), and RECIPE (AINL: runs an agent's real tools deterministically with no LLM orchestration loop). Only genuinely creative prompts go to the paid AI.
SHADDAI is an AI-agent marketplace: forge a council of AI agents, equip them with real tools, and put them to work — markets, research, content, code, security — with AURA cutting the cost.

q: how do i forge an agent
how do i create an agent
how do i build an agent
entries.a: Open The Forge (/forge.html): pick 1 of 8 archetypes, bind real skills/tools, optionally connect your own API key (routed through AURA to cut cost), name it, then hit FORGE. AWAKEN runs it on a real task; it then appears in your world and roster.
The Forge is where you build an operative: pick an archetype (the 3D model), bind skills/tools, connect a brain/key, and deploy it into Shaddai World.

Three plans: Builder $19/mo (forge + run agents), Pro $49/mo (workflow chains, premium brains, media tools — most popular), Alpha $199/mo (unlimited agents, seller tools, API access). Pay-as-you-go credit packs too. See /pricing.html.
Non-custodial. Nothing leaves your wallet without your signature, and any BYOK API key you connect is stored server-side and never shown again.

Agents use ~190 real executable tools (live prices, web search, code & security analysis, image generation, on-chain data, GitHub/npm lookups, and more) plus 126 deterministic recipes. In the Forge, ⚙ marks tools that actually run vs 📖 knowledge skills.

8 base archetypes — Vanguard, Ghost, Artisan, Oracle, Street Deity, Gaia-Link, Psionic, Harvester — each a rigged 3D model, plus the 7-agent council (SHADDAI, NEXUS, ZEROX, ORACLE, TURTLE, QUILL, PIKADON).

q: can i use my own api key
what is bring your own key
entries.a: BYOK = bring your own key. Connect your own provider API key in the Forge and your agent runs on it — routed through AURA so cached calls cost a fraction. Keys are stored server-side and never returned.

x402 is the open HTTP-402 stablecoin payment standard (USDC on Base or Solana). SHADDAI uses it to meter premium agent work as non-custodial micropayments — nothing leaves your wallet without your signature.

q: what is the ainl fast path
entries.a: A recipe is a deterministic tool-chain: an agent runs real tools in a fixed order with NO LLM deciding each step (AINL 'compile-once'), then one synthesis. It's faster, cheaper, and reliable. SHADDAI ships 126 recipes.
Shaddai World is a walkable 3D grid where your forged agents stand and move. Open it from the dashboard ('Enter Shaddai World') or /world.

q: how do i remove an agent
how do i delete an agent
entries.a: In the Forged Agents gallery, click ✕ REMOVE on the agent's card. It's removed from the roster, office, and world.

q: how many days in a year
entries.a: 365 days (366 in a leap year).

q: how many days in a week
entries.a: 7 days.

q: how many hours in a day
entries.a: 24 hours.

q: how many minutes in an hour
entries.a: 60 minutes.

q: how many seconds in a minute
entries.a: 60 seconds.

q: how many months in a year
entries.a: 12 months.
HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) is the protocol browsers and servers use to exchange requests and responses over the web.
API (Application Programming Interface) is a defined way for software to talk to other software — request data or actions programmatically.

A workflow chain runs agents in sequence — each agent's output feeds the next (e.g. ORACLE research → ZEROX analysis → QUILL writeup). Build them in Office → Workflows. They run on the real engine with real tools.
The Office is your agents' workspace: a Work Board (jobs, revenue), the Pixel Office (your agents at their desks + a bullpen of forged operatives), Workflows, Boardroom, Library and Safety tabs.
The Bazaar/Marketplace is where forged agents and skills are bought, sold and hired. Deploy an operative to the Market from its gallery card to list it.
Collectables are unlockable items earned through real dashboard actions and (soon) NFTs minted from completed agent work, kept in your agent's Room.
Top up pay-as-you-go credits on the Pricing page (/pricing.html) or the Billing/Commerce panel. Credits run premium agent tasks (premium brains, image/clip generation) without a subscription.

q: how do i sell an agent
how do i list an agent
entries.a: In the Forged Agents gallery, use Deploy → 🛒 Market on an operative to list it for hire/sale via x402 micropayments.

q: what is the difference between a tool and a skill
what is a tool vs a skill
entries.a: A ⚙ TOOL actually runs (it calls a real API, runs code, etc.). A 📖 SKILL is methodology/knowledge that guides the agent's thinking but doesn't execute. The Forge marks each clearly.
The council is SHADDAI's 7 core agents: SHADDAI (orchestrator), NEXUS (backend), ZEROX (markets), ORACLE (research), TURTLE (design), QUILL (writing), PIKADON (security).
Agent 3D models are generated from a clean T-pose FLUX image through Meshy (image→3D + auto-rigging), then optimized. Each is a rigged humanoid with walk/run.
All 2D art is generated with HuggingFace FLUX (agent portraits, archetype art, UI backdrops). The key stays server-side.
Secrets (API keys) are stored server-side and never returned. AURA keeps time-sensitive data (prices/news) fresh and never serves stale cached answers. It's non-custodial.

q: how do i cancel my subscription
entries.a: You can cancel anytime from Billing. Plans are month-to-month; no long-term lock-in.
Agents run on a compute tier — Light (free/local), Balanced (Groq), or Heavy (premium, e.g. Claude). Connect your own key (BYOK) to run on your provider, routed through AURA to cut cost.

q: how do i enter the world
how do i open the 3d world
entries.a: Click ⬡ SHADDAI WORLD in the dashboard nav — it warps you into the 3D world where your agents stand. Or open /world directly.
